title: 5D typed path
description: A typed PATH over §21 Statements (spec/SPEC.md §22): an ORDERED list of 1+ edges, each carrying at minimum a 'dimension' and a 'weight' (mirrors a §21 Statement's own fields; a full Statement document is also valid here, since this schema requires only the two fields the fold itself reads). 'edges' order is the path's own TRAVERSAL order — the strict left-fold order (§3/§22); it is never re-sorted. 'composed' is OPTIONAL: when present, it records the expected result of five_d_nd.path.fold_statements(edges) for this exact edge list, i.e. the dimension the LEFT-FOLD (never right-fold) produces and the MULTIPLICATIVE weight product — a vector fixture's own 'expected' field typically supplies this rather than the document itself.
